metadata.title: High-Contrast Monochrome Portrait with Bold Serif Overlay

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast black and white profile portrait of a man looking downward, featuring a heavy grain or stipple texture, with large, white, high-contrast serif typography positioned across the lower third of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark clothing merges into the bottom edge to create a solid base for text.
The bright white background provides a sharp silhouette for the facial profile.
The coarse texture of the image contrasts with the clean, sharp edges of the typography.
coreInvariants: Strict black and white color palette with no grays in the background.
Heavy, visible grain or stipple effect across the subject.
Text placed horizontally across the chest/shoulder area.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale profile headshot occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, angled towards the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eye and nose bridge form the central focal point, while the text anchors the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye follows the downward gaze of the subject from top-right to bottom-left, landing on the bold text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space on the left side balances the density of the subject on the right.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for shadows and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone stipple texture for skin and hair detail.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between background and subject.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick verticals and thin horizontals

typesetting.alignment: centered or justified across the width

composition.scale: Large, spanning nearly the full width
composition.overlap: Placed directly over the dark area of the subject
composition.relationshipToImage: Knockout white against dark subject matter

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for maximum impact and simplicity.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs.
Provides the elegant, modern serif look with vertical stress.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white profile portrait of a man with a textured stipple or halftone effect. The background must be pure white. The subject should be wearing dark clothing that creates a solid black area at the bottom of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, all-caps text in a high-contrast Modern Serif font (like Bodoni) in white. Position the text across the lower third, ensuring it is legible against the dark clothing of the subject.

verificationChecks: Is the image texture coarse and grainy?
Is the text a high-contrast serif in all-caps?
Is the text white and placed over the dark area of the subject?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color artifacts are present.
Verify the serif font has sharp, flat terminals.
Check that the stipple effect is consistent across the subject.
Confirm the text is perfectly horizontal and centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome photography + stipple texture + bold Modern Serif knockout text.
